title: Intrinsic properties ground the dispositions physics describes

statements.text: There are quiddities, properties that underlie the structure and dynamics physics describes. Where there is mathematico-causal structure there must be some categorical nature that realizes it, such as a categorical nature of an electron that grounds the dispositions physics ascribes to it. Russell argued that turning things into laws about other things must stop somewhere.

sources.quote: realism about quiddities, which states that there are quiddities, that is, properties that underlie the structure and dynamics physics describes

Obviously there must be a limit to this process, or else all the things in the world will merely be each other’s washing.
